offering_description.value: Provides satellite broadband, in-flight and maritime connectivity, and secure defense communications to airlines, consumers, enterprises and governments. Builds and operates satellite networks and sells terminals, ground equipment and defense electronics.

primary_products.value: satellite terminals and modems; ground network equipment; secure communications systems; defense electronics

primary_services.value: satellite broadband service; in-flight connectivity; maritime connectivity; government satellite communications services

customer_segment.value: B2B: airlines, maritime operators, enterprises, mobile network operators; B2C: residential broadband subscribers; B2G: defense departments and government agencies

end_markets.value: aviation; maritime; defense and government; telecommunications; consumer and enterprise broadband

revenue_model.value: product sales: satellite terminals, ground equipment and defense electronics; subscription: broadband and in-flight connectivity service plans; project or contract: government satellite and defense communications programs
revenue_model.category: product sales; subscription; project or contract

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: operates satellite fleet and ground networks, selling capacity to airlines and consumers; OEM / manufacturer: builds terminals and defense electronics sold to operators and governments; service provider: provides connectivity services to airlines, maritime and government customers
value_chain_position.category: asset operator; OEM / manufacturer; service provider

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Asia, Middle East, Africa, South America and oceans

specialization.value: related lines: satellite broadband services, connectivity for aviation and maritime, and government communications systems sharing satellite technology

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: airlines, governments and large enterprise accounts; partners / resellers: mobile operators and value-added resellers for terminals and service

regulatory_exposure.value: high: satellite spectrum licenses and export controls from the FCC and US government, plus defense contracting rules
